emitter_not_found.message: The infrared emitter {entity_id} used by {title} no longer exists. Reconfigure the integration to select another emitter.

receiver_not_found.message: The infrared receiver {entity_id} used by {title} no longer exists. Reconfigure the integration to select another receiver, or none.

emitter_not_found.description:
The infrared emitter {entity_id} used by {title} no longer exists, so the HDMI switch cannot be controlled.

Go to **Settings → Devices & services → SkycropHD HDMI Switch Infrared**, open the entry's menu and choose **Reconfigure** to select another emitter.
emitter_not_found.title: Infrared emitter of {title} is missing

receiver_not_found.description:
The infrared receiver {entity_id} used by {title} no longer exists.

Go to **Settings → Devices & services → SkycropHD HDMI Switch Infrared**, open the entry's menu and choose **Reconfigure** to select another receiver, or leave it empty.
receiver_not_found.title: Infrared receiver of {title} is missing
